title: Administration of Justice
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

program.section_heading: Administration of Justice - Associate of Science Degree and Certificate of Achievement - NAS504/C/NCE504
outcomes: Demonstrate knowledge of the breadth, scope and interconnectivity of the criminal justice system.
Demonstrate an understanding of the theories and research in the area of crime, criminality and criminal justice.
Demonstrate a basic knowledge of criminal law.
Demonstrate a knowledge of the implications of legal evidence in the processing of criminal cases.
Demonstrate a knowledge of the role of policing and the maintenance of favorable community relations.

notes: The catalog prints one combined section for the Associate of Science Degree and the Certificate of Achievement; the program requirements (27 units) and Program Learning Outcomes are shared by both awards and recorded here for the certificate.

Elective Courses: 'Complete 9 units from the following: Choose any elective courses in the discipline, or:' POLS-5 and SOC-20. Any ADJ (discipline) elective courses may also count toward the 9 units; these are not enumerated in the text, so only POLS-5 and SOC-20 are listed in the block. Reviewer may wish to confirm whether the six required ADJ courses can double-count (presumably not).
open_elective_units left null because the electives are restricted to the discipline or the listed courses, not open to any course.
Codes recorded as printed with hyphens (ADJ-1 etc.); they correspond to closed-list codes ADJ 1 etc.
